mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP signals a sudden contraction in economic activity that will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a 2%+ qoq GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending power, which will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative in periods following a 0.5pp+ 2-month rise in UNRATE (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings that will positively impact equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of INDPRO vs. SPX 5-day returns remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will increase borrowing costs and compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances following a 0.5pp+ 1-month rise in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending that will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a 10%+ yoy decline in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in payroll employment signals strengthening labor market conditions and increased consumer spending power that will positively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of PAYEMS vs. SPX 20-day returns remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals increasing inflationary pressures that will negatively impact real equity returns and valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX real 60-day returns are not significantly negative in periods following a 0.5%+ mom rise in CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real consumer spending signals strengthening consumer demand and increased corporate earnings that will positively impact equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods following a 1%+ mom rise in RSAFS (t-test p > 0.1).
